title: api.count_cache_key
description: Key under which the invoices, customer-invoices and fees index endpoints cache their total count (BE-API-26, BE-API-27). The request's query parameters are first reduced to the endpoint's permitted scalar filters (invoices: amount_from, amount_to, currency, invoice_type, issuing_date_from, issuing_date_to, page, partially_paid, payment_dispute_lost, payment_overdue, payment_status, payment_statuses, per_page, purchase_order_number, search_term, self_billed, settlements, status, statuses, and the object `metadata`; array values and unknown keys are dropped; fees: fee_type, payment_status, external_subscription_id, external_customer_id, billable_metric_code, currency, event_transaction_id and the created/failed/succeeded/refunded _from/_to bounds, then `page` and `per_page` are added, null when absent). `page` is removed, `organization_id` added, every object becomes the list of its [key, value] pairs sorted by key (recursively), the result is serialised as compact JSON (`preimage`) and key = 'pagination_count/<invoices|fees>/' + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the pre-image. The customer-scoped invoices list uses the invoices key and does not include the customer.

organization_id.description: Organization identifier (any string; the reference uses its UUID).

customer_external_id.description: Path parameter of the customer-scoped invoices list.

query.description: Query parameters as parsed from the URL: string values, arrays of strings (`k[]=v`), objects (`metadata[k]=v`).

preimage.description: Exact JSON text that was hashed.
